a.xlink:title: Upstream PROG(VLAN), 802.1AD arm: the outer S-tag must be followed by exactly one 802.1Q C-tag.
Upstream PROG(MPLS): read one label entry, stop, BPF_OK.

Kernel parse_ip_proto encap arms (IPPROTO_IPIP / IPPROTO_IPV6, default flags: STOP_AT_ENCAP off): mark is_encap and re-enter the state machine as the inner family — pure back edges, no header read; the max_depth budget bounds the nesting.

Kernel IPPROTO_GRE arm, step order is the crux: version != 0 is an immediate BPF_OK — no thoff advance, no is_encap, the optional region never read. Only version 0 walks the C/K/S optionals (parse_gre_opt), sets is_encap, and dispatches.
Kernel PROG(IPV6OP): walk the option, dispatch on its own next_header — HopByHop/DestOpts loop back (self-edge).
Kernel PROG(IPV6FR) under default flags: read the fragment header and stop (BPF_OK), always.
TEB (0x6558) re-enters parse_ethernet itself: the kernel reads the inner Ethernet and runs its full parse_eth_proto dispatcher, so inner VLAN/MPLS/IPvX all live.
